2608.31059.title: When Can We Work in Embedding Space? What Text Embeddings Preserve
2608.31059.paper_summary: When do text embeddings work as inputs to empirical analysis? Their use rests on an assumption: that we can trade text for its low-dimensional embedding, and lose little in doing so. I make that assumption precise under a generative model in which documents are mixtures of latent topics. I study two uses---clustering units in embedding space and controlling for high-dimensional text. A cluster of embeddings is a set of documents with similar topic mixtures; controlling for the embedding is equivalent to controlling for the topic mixture, so validity reduces to whether that mixture captures the confounding. In an application to 363 U.S. metropolitan areas, embedding-based clusters of LLM-generated economic descriptions recover interpretable economic archetypes and separate local employment dynamics more sharply than clustering on model residuals, or on a curated set of industry and demographic covariates.
2608.31059.paper_summary_zh: 當文本嵌入作為實證分析的輸入時，何時有效？它們的使用基於一個假設：我們可以用文本的低維嵌入來替代文本，並且這樣做損失不大。我在一個生成模型下精確地闡明了這個假設，其中文件是潛在主題的混合。我研究了兩種用途——在嵌入空間中進行聚類單元以及控制高維文本。嵌入的聚類是一組具有相似主題混合的文件；控制嵌入等同於控制主題混合，因此有效性歸結於該混合是否捕捉到混淆。在對363個美國大都市區的應用中，基於嵌入的LLM生成經濟描述的聚類恢復了可解釋的經濟原型，並且比在模型殘差或經過策劃的行業和人口統計協變量上進行聚類更清晰地區分了當地就業動態。
2608.31059.author: Simon Freyaldenhoven et.al.
